profile.name: 快门时序控制组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于在实验时序中表示和调度快门输出通道。它基于数字输出抽象，能够在编排实验序列时自动补偿快门开启/关闭延迟，并生成供实验控制系统执行的定时指令与代码，常用于激光束遮断、放光窗口控制等场景。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that represents and schedules a shutter output channel within an experimental timing sequence. Built on a digital-output abstraction, it automatically compensates for shutter open/close delays during sequence programming and generates timed instructions and code for the experiment control system, commonly for beam blocking and optical exposure-window control.

registry.description: Optical Shutter Controller是一款表征设备，主要功能包括使能、关闭、打开、禁用、触发。支持Signal, Slot, add device等操作。
